name: Haus Leonhard
beschreibung:
The Haus Leonhard is located on the outskirts of a village in Tirol, surrounded by meadows and forests. The quiet surroundings and traditional construction shape the atmosphere of the inn.

The rooms are furnished with local wood and each has a bathroom. For breakfast and dinner, regional dishes are served in the inn's restaurant.

In the surrounding area, there are hiking trails in summer and cross-country ski trails in winter. The location is suitable as a starting point for activities in both seasons.
